pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.
   D. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.
   B. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq .

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.
   C. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Abbasid Dynasty 4.2 Fatimid Dynasty 4.3 Islam in Africa 4.4 Influence of Islam i and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Abbasid Dynasty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fatimid Dynasty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. C — Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. A — Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Abbasid Dynasty 4.2 Fatimid Dynasty 4.3 Islam in Africa 4.4 Influence of Islam i; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Abbasid Dynasty; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fatimid Dynasty; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
